# A picture a program keeps in a var of its own, beside the derived value
# that made it, is retained there: gtk4's `Picture` names `refPicture` as its
# retain, the stub counts the holder, and when the URL moves on the derived
# value releases its reference while the var keeps its own. Teardown releases
# both, and the tracker is left holding nothing.

env PATH=

sngl test --simulate gtk4 app.sngl
stdout '^ok   2 tests, 0 failures$'
! stdout 'leak'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import gtk4 "sngl:platform/gtk4"
import "sngl:test"

component page ui.node {
    var url = "a.png"

    func picture() => gtk4.loadPicture(url)

    var last = picture()

    func next() {
        last = picture()
        url = "b.png"
    }

    ui.vbox {
        ui.image {
            gtk4.ImageUrl(url=url, picture=picture)
        }
        ui.image {
            gtk4.ImageUrl(url=url, picture=last)
        }
        ui.button(text="next", @click {
            next()
        })
    }
}

func testKeepsTheLast(t test.Test, c page) {
    c.next()
    t.assert(c.url == "b.png")
}

func testHolds(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.assert(c.url == "a.png")
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    page
}
